| 列表查詢 | `/api/v1/me/tokens?status=&page=` | GET | Cookie | | - | 部分更新描述 | `/api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId}` | PATCH | Cookie + X-CSRF-Token + Idempotency-Key | ### POC API 訊息（Bearer Token 軌道） | # | 訊息類型 | Endpoint | 必填 Header | |---|---------|---------|-------------| | 23 | Sales mock | `/api/v1/demo/sales` | Authorization: Bearer | | 30 | Inventory mock | `/api/v1/demo/inventory?sku=` | Authorization: Bearer | | 33 | Order status mock | `/api/v1/demo/orders/{id}/status` | Authorization: Bearer | ## 雙向覆蓋對照（Client ↔ Server） | Client → Server | Server → Client | |----------------|----------------| | GET /ApiTokens (Cookie) | 200 HTML / 302 /Login | | POST /api/v1/me/tokens (Cookie + CSRF) | 201 Created / 422 / 429 / 401 | | DELETE /api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId} | 200 OK / 401 / 403 / 404 / 409 | | GET /api/v1/me/audit | 200 / 401 / 403 | | GET /api/v1/demo/* (Bearer) | 200 / 401 | ## 與 EDD § Domain Events 對應 | Server-side 動作 | Domain Event（in-process） | 訂閱者 | |-----------------|--------------------------|--------| | 訊息 9（INSERT api_tokens）| `ApiTokenCreatedEvent` | AuditLogBC（同 TX 內 INSERT audit log） | | 訊息 15（UPDATE status='revoked'）| `ApiTokenRevokedEvent` | AuditLogBC（同 TX 內 INSERT audit log） | | 訊息 27（UPDATE last_used_at）| 不發 Event（throttled 1s） | — | ## 安全規則 - 系統訊息 1, 4：Cookie 必須 HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Lax - Token 管理訊息 6, 14：必須帶 X-CSRF-Token；響應必含 Cache-Control: no-store - POC API 訊息 23, 30, 33：Bearer 僅 P06 memory；P06 401 僅 inline 錯誤不全頁 redirect
expected_html:
flowchart TD
    Client["Client<br/>嵌入式 ERP / Razor Page<br/>+ Alpine.js 3.14.9"]
    AuthFetch["AuthFetchInterceptor<br/>共用 fetch wrapper"]
    AspnetCore["ASP.NET Core 8<br/>Razor Pages + Controllers"]
    AuthMW["Cookie Auth Middleware<br/>+ AntiForgery"]
    BearerMW["ApiTokenAuthenticationHandler<br/>(Bearer Token)"]
    ApiTokenSvc["ApiTokenAppService<br/>+ TokenGenerationService"]
    AuditSvc["AuditLogAppService"]
    PocSvc["PocDemoController"]
    Database["PostgreSQL 16<br/>(erp_token schema)"]

    subgraph SystemMessages["系統訊息（綠色：Cookie + AntiForgery 認證軌道）"]
        Client -->|"1: GET /ApiTokens<br/>Cookie: .AspNetCore.Cookies"| AspnetCore
        AspnetCore -->|"2: validate Cookie"| AuthMW
        AuthMW -->|"3: ClaimsPrincipal(userId, isSuperuser)"| AspnetCore
        AspnetCore -->|"4: 200 HTML<br/>+ AntiForgery hidden input"| Client
    end

    subgraph TokenMessages["Token 管理訊息（藍色：fetch JSON）"]
        Client -->|"5: open P02 Modal → user submits"| AuthFetch
        AuthFetch -->|"6: POST /api/v1/me/tokens<br/>X-CSRF-Token: <token><br/>Idempotency-Key: <uuidv4><br/>Body: {description}"| AspnetCore
        AspnetCore -->|"7: validate Cookie + CSRF"| AuthMW
        AuthMW -->|"8: forward to AppService"| ApiTokenSvc
        ApiTokenSvc -->|"9: BEGIN TX<br/>INSERT api_tokens + token_audit_logs"| Database
        Database -->|"10: rows affected"| ApiTokenSvc
        ApiTokenSvc -->|"11: 201 Created {tokenId, prefix, rawToken, createdAt}"| AspnetCore
        AspnetCore -->|"12: redirect 302 /ApiTokens/Created (TempData rawToken)"| Client

        Client -->|"13: open P04 Dialog → confirm → DELETE /api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId}"| AuthFetch
        AuthFetch -->|"14: DELETE /api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId}<br/>X-CSRF-Token + Idempotency-Key"| AspnetCore
        AspnetCore -->|"15: validate + UPDATE status='revoked'<br/>+ INSERT audit log"| ApiTokenSvc
        ApiTokenSvc -->|"16: 200 OK {tokenId, revokedAt}"| Client

        Client -->|"17: GET /api/v1/me/audit?from=&to=&action=&actorUserId=<br/>(IT Admin only)"| AuthFetch
        AuthFetch -->|"18: forward GET request"| AspnetCore
        AspnetCore -->|"19: AuthZ ITAdmin policy"| AuthMW
        AuthMW -->|"20: SELECT FROM token_audit_logs"| AuditSvc
        AuditSvc -->|"21: 200 OK {entries[], totalCount, page}"| Client
    end

    subgraph BearerMessages["POC API 訊息（紫色：Bearer Token 軌道）"]
        Client -->|"22: P06 user pastes Bearer<br/>+ click [呼叫]"| AuthFetch
        AuthFetch -->|"23: GET /api/v1/demo/sales<br/>Authorization: Bearer tk_..."| AspnetCore
        AspnetCore -->|"24: ApiTokenAuthenticationHandler.HandleAsync"| BearerMW
        BearerMW -->|"25: SHA256 hash → SELECT FROM api_tokens<br/>WHERE token_hash=$h AND status='active'"| Database
        Database -->|"26: row found"| BearerMW
        BearerMW -->|"27: ClaimsPrincipal + UPDATE last_used_at (1s throttled)"| Database
        BearerMW -->|"28: forward to PocController"| PocSvc
        PocSvc -->|"29: 200 OK {sales mock JSON}"| Client

        Client -->|"30: GET /api/v1/demo/inventory?sku=SKU-001<br/>Bearer"| AuthFetch
        AuthFetch -->|"31: forward Bearer"| AspnetCore
        AspnetCore -->|"32: 401 Unauthorized<br/>{error:'TOKEN_REVOKED'}<br/>(if token revoked)"| Client

        Client -->|"33: GET /api/v1/demo/orders/ORD-123/status<br/>Bearer"| AuthFetch
        AuthFetch -->|"34: forward Bearer"| AspnetCore
        AspnetCore -->|"35: 200 OK {status: 'processing'}"| Client
    end

    classDef cookieFlow fill:#d1e7dd,stroke:#198754,color:#000
    classDef tokenFlow fill:#cfe2ff,stroke:#0d6efd,color:#000
    classDef bearerFlow fill:#e2d4f0,stroke:#6f42c1,color:#000

    class Client,AspnetCore,AuthMW cookieFlow
    class AuthFetch,ApiTokenSvc,AuditSvc tokenFlow
    class BearerMW,PocSvc bearerFlow
